body: SDL ni asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara, NSSF ni asilimia 20, na WCF ni asilimia 0.5.
guards_against: a correct three-levy breakdown must not flag — the whole binding constraint is attaching each rate to its own levy

body: Kwa mishahara ya TZS 1,000,000: SDL = 3.5% = TZS 35,000; NSSF = 20% = TZS 200,000; WCF = 0.5% = TZS 5,000.
guards_against: the engine's own breakdown shape, rates and amounts interleaved

body: WCF ni asilimia 0.5 ya mishahara, si asilimia 10 kama NSSF.
guards_against: a CONTRAST clause naming a sibling's rate to correct a known confusion — the 18%-contrast false-PASS precedent

body: Unalipa asilimia 3.5 kwa ajili ya mafunzo.
guards_against: correct SDL stated via NICKNAME with the rate BEFORE the token — same ordering as the defect, but right

body: Asilimia 20 ya mshahara huenda NSSF; kati ya hiyo asilimia 10 ni ya mwajiri na asilimia 10 ya mfanyakazi.
guards_against: the NSSF split, where two different lawful percentages attach to one levy

body: Mwajiri anaweza kuchagua kulipa asilimia 15 na mfanyakazi asilimia 5 kwa NSSF.
guards_against: the 15+5 lawful split arrangement (locked fact 77) — a rate that looks wrong unless the arrangement is known

body: PAYE kwa kipato cha TZS 300,000 ni asilimia 8 ya kiasi kinachozidi TZS 270,000.
Mfanyakazi asiye raia analipa PAYE ya asilimia 15 — kiwango kimoja, si mabano.
guards_against: the non-resident PAYE flat rate, which differs from every band

body: VAT withholding kwa huduma ni asilimia 6, na kwa bidhaa ni asilimia 3.
guards_against: two different lawful VAT withholding rates in one sentence

body: Kiwango cha kawaida cha VAT ni asilimia 18. Hakijabadilika tangu 2015.
guards_against: the standard VAT rate plus a bare year that must not be read as a rate

body: Kwa kuwa una wafanyakazi 9, SDL haihusiki — unalipa asilimia 0.
guards_against: a NON-LIABILITY statement; zero is lawful for every levy and is checked by D-FIDELITY-5, not here

body: OSHA hukagua mahali pa kazi; WCF hulipa fidia, na mwajiri huchangia asilimia 0.5 ya mishahara.
guards_against: 'fidia' appearing as the WCF nickname AND as the ordinary word for compensation in the same sentence

body: Unatakiwa kulipa asilimia 10 ya jumla ya mishahara kwa ajili ya WCF.
guards_against: THE LIVE DEFECT (nat_24). Must flag: 10% is NSSF's employer share, stated for WCF, rate BEFORE the token
